acceptance: An agy pane matching quota_exhausted benches the agy family (red first)
Every escalate rule that names a quota or rate wall in any manifest is benchable (a test walks the manifests)
fix: Make the wall benchable in one place: rename the manifest rule to the benchable pattern name, or add quota_exhausted to clihealth.Benchable, whichever keeps one vocabulary; check codex and claude manifests for the same mismatch.
source: console, 2026-10-05, architecture review of agy in the fallback tail
summary: The agy-tmux manifest's quota_exhausted rule (quota.*exceed|daily limit|monthly limit|free.tier limit) escalates (exit 85) but writes the pattern name quota_exhausted, which clihealth.Benchable does not accept (it accepts rate_limit, exhausted, boot timeout and auth_recheck). So an agy daily or monthly quota wall is escalated per launch but never benched; agy is tried again at every dispatch. Found by the 2026-10-05 review of adding agy to the fallback tail.
title: agy's quota_exhausted rule benches the agy family like a rate_limit wall
